Problem Statement:
Create a Java program that demonstrates the use of the new keyword to dynamically create objects and arrays. The program should read the number of elements from the user, create an array of that size, and then read values into the array. 
Input Description:
The first line contains an integer n, the size of the array. The next n lines each contain an integer to fill the array. 
Output Description:
The program should output the contents of the array. 
Explanation:
The program should read an integer n to determine the size of an array. It should then dynamically allocate an array of integers using the new keyword and read n integers from the user to fill the array. Finally, it should display the contents of the array.
